items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. The clothing and jewellery are also excluded under §4.3(d) and (f) as personal property kept in a vehicle away from the insured location, so the payable threshold is €0.
Sections 4.3(e) and 5.2.5 exclude the private car and the trip-related vehicle costs. The conditional estimate is 1 × €79, but the payable threshold is €0.
